newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai gold imports up four pct in first nine mths.
newsitem.headline: Dubai gold imports up four pct in first nine mths.

text.p: Gold imports into Dubai rose almost four percent to 254,599 kg in the first nine months of 1996 from 244,883 kg in the same period last year, the World Gold Council (WGC) said.

"1995 had been a record year for gold. An increase on those figures is only a reinforcement of the fact that gold is a premium investment tool," WGC Middle East and India chief executive Rolf Schneebeli said in a statement.
In the third quarter imports rose 4.7 percent to 85,325 kg versus the same three-month period last year.
In the first nine months of the year Dubai imported gold from 27 countries, with most coming from Switzerland, Britain and South Africa.
"While the demand for gold locally has also seen a rise, the traditional markets like India, Pakistan and Iran to which Dubai caters are also fuelling this rise," Schneebeli said.
The Geneva-based WGC is a non-profit association owned by major gold producers and monitors about 75 percent of the world's markets.
